controls.title: SWIFT environment protection (secure zone)
controls.objective: SWIFT-related components operate in a dedicated secure zone.
controls.evidenceHint: Network diagram, jump host, Alliance Cloud connector placement.

controls.title: Back-office data-flow security
controls.objective: Confidentiality, integrity, and mutual authentication on flows between the messaging interface and back office.
controls.evidenceHint: mTLS config, LAU/TLS design, adapter allowlist.

controls.title: Transaction business controls
controls.objective: Maker-checker and dual control over sensitive actions.
controls.evidenceHint: Payment release requires distinct checker plus step-up TOTP.

controls.title: Password policy
controls.evidenceHint: Policy in IdentityService; no shared mailboxes as login IDs.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.objective: MFA for end-user login to the messaging interface; NIST SP 800-63B AAL2 guidance.
controls.evidenceHint: TOTP enrollment mandatory before session; step-up on release.

controls.title: Logical access control
controls.objective: RBAC with least privilege and tenant isolation.
controls.evidenceHint: Role enum + tenant_id on every business row.

controls.title: Logging and monitoring
controls.objective: Immutable audit of security and payment events.

controls.title: Cyber incident response
controls.objective: Detect, contain, notify SWIFT and customers.
